landing.headline: Master every foundation before unlocking what comes next.
landing.subheadline: Smart-Tech replaces flat topic checklists with a verified prerequisite graph. Learners prove mastery through quizzes, follow shortest valid study paths, and keep every progress record intact when instructors restructure courses.
landing.howItWorksDesc: Three deterministic graph guarantees built into every course.
landing.pillar1Desc: Instructors connect concepts with directed prerequisites while backend cycle detection prevents circular deadlocks.
landing.pillar2Desc: Completing a reading does not unlock advanced modules alone. Passing each quiz above the threshold unlocks dependent concepts.
landing.pillar3Desc: Pick any target concept like Algorithms or Recursion. Smart-Tech computes the minimal ordered route skipping mastered topics.
landing.demoAccountsDesc: Launch immediately as an instructor or test three distinct learner mastery profiles.
landing.catalogDesc: Filter by subject or search topics to inspect the live concept map and enroll.
landing.noMatchingCourses: No courses match your current search or category filter.
landing.aboutBody: Built for structured technical mastery, Smart-Tech enforces prerequisite order deterministically using 3-color cycle detection and Kahn's topological sorting. When instructors split a module or adjust dependencies mid-term, existing learner scores and archived concept history remain preserved.
landing.contactDesc: Questions about prerequisite course authoring, department onboarding, or accessibility support? Reach our engineering team directly.
